ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there is a rhombus-shaped connection structure, with a total of five circles: four outer circles at the top, bottom, left, and right, and one inner circle in the center, with a question mark in the center circle indicating the unknown number. method.method_draft: Use the total-product complement. Read from the image that there are exactly five circles: four outer circles and one inner circle. From the text, take the five numbers as 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and the product of the four outer-circle numbers as 360. Compute the product of all five numbers: 3×4×5×6×7 = 2520. Since all five numbers consist of the four outer numbers times the inner number, divide 2520 by 360 to get the inner number: 2520 ÷ 360 = 7.
